indications: Donepezil hydrochloride is indicated for the treatment of dementia of the Alzheimer's type. Efficacy has been demonstrated in patients with mild, moderate, and severe Alzheimer's disease.
contraindications: Mild to Moderate Alzheimer's disease : 5 mg to 10 mg administered once daily ( 2.1 ) Moderate to Severe Alzheimer’s Disease : 10 mg administered once daily ( 2.2)
